The classes that describe a UI, open and close it, keep its state and its files, run its tasks and shortcuts, and animate it when it opens and closes.
Learn: [UIs](/use/learn/describing-the-ui/uis/), [Transitions](/use/learn/style-and-motion/transitions/), [Stores and properties](/use/learn/state/stores-and-properties/).

| Type | Kind | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [`HotReload`](/reference/ui/hotreload/) | class | Watches the class files of open UIs in dev mode and reloads a UI when its classes change. |
| [`JOID`](/reference/ui/joid/) | class | Entry point that opens and closes UIs, finds the open ones and runs code once JOID has loaded. |
| [`JOIDEnv`](/reference/ui/joidenv/) | class | The mode JOID runs in and the folders where it writes its data and its caches. |
| [`JOIDLog`](/reference/ui/joidlog/) | class | Prints the messages of JOID with the [JOID] prefix, information on the standard output and warnings on the error output. |
| [`PopTransition`](/reference/ui/poptransition/) | class | Transition that grows a UI from 75 % of its size when it opens and shrinks it back when it closes, in 130 ms, around its anchor. |
| [`Shortcut`](/reference/ui/shortcut/) | class | A key combination attached to a UI or a node that fires its listeners when the user presses it. |
| [`ShortcutEvent`](/reference/ui/shortcutevent/) | class | Event that a shortcut passes to its listeners when it fires. |
| [`Task`](/reference/ui/task/) | class | Code that runs once after a delay, or on a period, while it is attached to a UI or a node. |
| [`TaskEvent`](/reference/ui/taskevent/) | class | Event that a task passes to its listeners when it runs. |
| [`Transition`](/reference/ui/transition/) | class | The pair of steps that a UI plays when it opens and when it closes. |
| [`TransitionDrawing`](/reference/ui/transitiondrawing/) | interface | Function that draws a UI for a progress of its transition step, around the body that draws its nodes. |
| [`TransitionStep`](/reference/ui/transitionstep/) | class | One step of a transition, opening or closing, that animates a progress from 0 to 1 and draws the UI through its drawing. |
| [`UI`](/reference/ui/ui/) | class | Base class of a screen, an overlay or a popup that builds its node tree in init() and draws it on the design canvas. |
| [`UIProperty`](/reference/ui/uiproperty/) | annotation | Annotation that makes JOID remember a field of a UI on disk, from one run of the application to the next. |
| [`UIPropertyHook`](/reference/ui/uipropertyhook/) | class | Reads and writes the @UIProperty fields of a UI in its property file. |
| [`UIStore`](/reference/ui/uistore/) | class | Base class of a store, a container of values that lives as long as its scope and that several UIs can share. |
| [`UIStoreData`](/reference/ui/uistoredata/) | annotation | Annotation that gives a store its scope and the name of its file. |
| [`UIStoreHook`](/reference/ui/uistorehook/) | class | Creates, caches, saves and destroys the stores that the UIs use. |
| [`UIStoreScope`](/reference/ui/uistorescope/) | enum | How long a store lives and which UIs share it. |
| [`UIView`](/reference/ui/uiview/) | class | Converts between the screen pixels of the window and the design pixels of a UI, from the window size, the anchor, the interface scale and the zoom. |
